name: Certified cost or pricing data (FAR text)
note: CONFLICT with statute. FAR text. For NASA prime contracts entered into after June 30, 2026 the statute sets $10,000,000 (10 U.S.C. 3702(a)(1)(A), Pub. L. 119-60 sec. 1804(c); NASA covered by 10 U.S.C. 3063(6), 3064(a)). NASA has not issued a deviation as of Oct 7, 2026, and there is no FAR change yet; FAR Case 2026-003 (91 FR 59406) still proposes $2.5 million. Contracts entered into on or before June 30, 2026 keep the threshold stated in the contract. Show both.

name: Certified cost or pricing data (statute, contracts after June 30, 2026)
citation: 10 U.S.C. 3702(a)(1)(A), (a)(3)(A)(i), as amended by Pub. L. 119-60 sec. 1804(c) (Dec. 18, 2025); applies to NASA through 10 U.S.C. 3063(6) and 3064(a)
note: Governs NASA prime contracts entered into after June 30, 2026 (price expected to exceed $10,000,000). Certified data below this figure need an HCA written, nondelegable determination (10 U.S.C. 3704; RFO FAR 15.403-3(e)). RFO FAR 15.403-3(a) still reads $2.5 million. NASA has not issued a deviation as of Oct 7, 2026. Modifications keep the threshold stated in the contract.
